newsitem.title: UK: BFI up seven as freight market remains firm.
newsitem.headline: BFI up seven as freight market remains firm.

text.p: The Baltic Frieght Index was marked up seven points on Wednesday to 1,477 and brokers said generally firm conditions persisted in the freight market especially for early positions.
Panamaxes for december loading were in strong demand in the USGulf and River Plate as well as the North Pacific with some strong timecharter rates reported in these areas.
Romac for example fixed Panayia Moutsaina 68,676 dwt delivery, USGulf mid Dec trip Aqaba at $14,500 daily plus $280,000 bonus.
Yukong fixed Luise Oldendorff 77,873 dwt delivery prompt Bangkok trip via Richards Bay redelivery Spain at $9,000 daily.
There was a particular shortage of Handy-sizes as well as Panamaxes for early posiitons in Argentina and Brazil.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was up 35 to 15 points and turnover totalled 71 lots.
